mentions.description: A desktop client for building and sharing MCP Apps within a team. MCP Apps provide visual interfaces for AI, making AI more accessible for every role in a company and better suited to internal tool use-cases.
mentions.problem: AI without a visual UI is a black box and hard to access for every role in a company.
mentions.audience: Teams using internal tool use-cases, including every role in a company.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Creature - A desktop client for building/sharing MCP Apps within your team.
